question.text: Under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) 2002, the threshold for a Cash Transaction Report (CTR) is aggregated cash transactions exceeding:

answer.text: Rs. 10 lakh per month per customer

explanation.text: The Logic: Under PMLA, records must be maintained for all cash transactions of a value above Rs. 10 lakh, as well as for series of integrally connected cash transactions individually below Rs. 10 lakh that, in aggregate, exceed Rs. 10 lakh within one calendar month. The Trap: The Rs. 10 lakh threshold applies to single cash transactions as well as to aggregated connected transactions in a calendar month — there is no separate Rs. 1 lakh single-transaction trigger under this provision. Note: Transaction monitoring should track cumulative cash activity per client over the calendar month to catch connected-series breaches.
